decision: Required to start the race from the back of the starting grid.
event_name: Red Bull Toro Rosso Honda Document 25 Date 23 June 2018 Time 13:26 2018 FRENCH GRAND PRIX 21 - 24 June 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 24), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: A 4th Internal Combustion Engine (ICE), 4th Turbo Charger (TC), 4th Motor Generator Unit Heat (MGU-H), 3rd Motor Generator Unit - Kinetic (MGU-K), 3rd Energy Store and 3rd Control Electronics have been used.
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 (a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the back of the starting grid.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Articles 23.3 a) and 23.3 b). The team notified the Technical Delegate regarding the change of the power unit elements on the 22nd June, at 20:06. Garry Connelly Enzo Spano Yannick Dalmas Jean-Marie Krempff
